generation: Generation 2 — Capability Architecture & Symbiotic Platform Engineering

research.cycle_semantics: minimum_full_cycles is a mandatory floor; target_full_cycles is a maturity checkpoint for global saturation reassessment, not an upper bound. There is no maximum cycle count.
research.continuation_rule: Cycle count never authorizes CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS by itself. Continue while material findings, gaps, divergences or unresolved cross-cutting primitives remain; transition only when saturation and completeness gates are satisfied.
research.late_cycle_selection_rule: As saturation increases, prefer research-by-exception and do not routinely reopen SATURATED capabilities without material new evidence or contradiction.
research.saturation_rule: SATURATED requires principal representatives covered and two consecutive eligible revisits with no material new architectural finding, or remaining questions requiring repository validation. Material findings reset the streak.
research_evidence_classes: consolidated systems and official product documentation
research.candidate_inventory_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/CAPABILITY_DISCOVERY_REGISTER.md plus prior state history and capability dossiers; compact representations do not revoke prior candidates
research.historical_coverage_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/REPRESENTATIVE_COVERAGE.md and capability dossiers; all prior coverage remains authoritative and unsuperseded
research.finding_inventory_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/FINDING_INDEX.md plus capability dossiers and prior state history; compact state does not revoke prior findings
